description:
The extractor calls `checker.ParseFile(... ) |> Async.RunSynchronously` with no timeout. If the F# file is extremely large or triggers a pathological case in FCS, the parse will hang indefinitely.

Fix: Add a timeout parameter to `Async.RunSynchronously(computation, timeout = 30000)`. Exit with code 2 on timeout with a clear error message to stderr.
title: F# extractor: add timeout to FCS parse
